records.title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
records.reason: The contribution is a dataset and fine-tuning resource, not inference efficiency.

records.title: MeshFlow: Efficient Artistic Mesh Generation via MeshVAE and Flow-based Diffusion Transformer
records.reason: The speedup is concrete but specific to 3D mesh generation and a change from autoregressive to diffusion generation; transfer to text-LLM inference is uncertain despite the linked attention/kernel lineage.

records.title: Trust-Region Behavior Blending for On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: The full text evaluates training trajectories and benchmark accuracy; it does not propose a deployed inference optimization.

records.title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
records.reason: The full text supports agent-memory relevance, but does not report reduced input tokens, latency, or serving cost; retain as borderline due to the linked memory lineage.

records.title: SD-Search: On-Policy Hindsight Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Reasoning
records.reason: Avoiding teacher inference is a training-pipeline saving; the method does not reduce inference cost for deployed reasoning.
